visual_contract.era: BLACK SKY upper atmosphere and near-Earth orbit
visual_contract.materials: thermal ceramic, graphite, dark cobalt structure, radiators and physical attitude control
visual_contract.field_rule: cyan-white light restricted to sensors, field apertures and charge hardware
visual_contract.ancestry: recognizably evolved from human military and industrial machinery, never alien

process.orientation: attack noses or primary rails facing down toward player
process.alpha_review: composited over purple atmosphere-space plate; no matte halo
process.alpha: 20 percent threshold, preserved separately during palette remap
process.palette: one shared 31-colour RGB palette plus transparency

runtime_animation.bank: all five orbital craft use discrete left/neutral/right held poses selected from smoothed real lateral motion
runtime_animation.destruction: cold debris, field collapse and smoke consequence
